lines: I'm hurt and completely out of food.
I can't recover without something to eat.
My food is gone, and these wounds are not closing.
I've got nothing left to heal with.
I need food or a healing potion.
My recovery supplies are empty.
I'm starving and still wounded.
There isn't a bite of food left in my pack.
I need something restorative before I get back on my feet.
Hunger is making these injuries harder to bear.
I used the last of my food trying to recover.
I cannot mend while my stomach is empty.
Please bring me food before my condition gets worse.
I checked every slot and found no recovery supplies.
A meal would help me start healing again.
I am too weak to keep going without food.
The wounds are still open because I have nothing to restore my strength.
I need help. My pack is empty and I am badly hurt.
I can recover if someone brings me something to eat.
Do not send me back into danger like this. I need food first.
